torch.rule: A runner takes the torch for every finished week that closed green with every trade inside the rules (weeks without a trade are skipped), and for every trading day where each trade kept the rules (1 trade a day, stop beyond the sweep, entries 02:00-15:30, flat by 15:55, hands off). One break puts the flame out.

grove.rule: One olive tree per account. It grows with the eval's progress to the target (a funded account is a full tree), one ring per $500 of profit, one olive per winning trade. A tree below its start balance looks thirsty.

amphorae.rule: One amphora per closed trade. Long = a horse rising, short = a dolphin diving. Bright clay = win, dark clay = loss, pale clay = a scratch (under $5 either way).

statues.rule: The best winning trades (biggest $ first; the first is the record) and every eval pass and payout stand in the hall.

stoic.why: A quiet day with no fresh trade: a line on today's task.
stoic.text: Hold every hour in your grasp. Lay hold of to-day's task, and you will not need to depend so much upon to-morrow's.
stoic.author: Seneca
